rules.statement: The mere acceptance of rent after the termination of a tenancy does not create a new contractual tenancy, and there is no presumption that such acceptance waives the notice to terminate.
rules.supporting_quote: "With regard to the payment of rent after a notice to quit, however, that result has never followed. If a proper notice to quit has been given in respect of a periodic tenancy, such as a yearly tenancy, the effect of the notice is to bring the tenancy to an end just as effectually as if there has been a term which has expired. Therefore, the tenancy having been brought to an end by a notice to quit, a payment of rent after the termination of the tenancy would only operate in favour of the tenant if it could be shown that the parties intended that there should be a new tenancy."
